correctness.rationale: For arbitrary positive block probabilities, splitting each ordered coarse flux into destination-weighted clone allocations gives the exact KL chain-rule decomposition. Within-block reversible exchanges give c_i P_i times the Jeffreys divergence from the target conditional law. All terms are nonnegative and vanish only at those target conditional laws, proving exact minimum preservation; stationarity is an exact balance identity. The three-state generator has stationary pi=(101,85,506)/692 and nonzero cycle affinity. Exact rational 32-term log series proves 50 sigma(pi)>59 sigma(P*), which forces a nonvanishing scaled gap on complete 3n-vertex graphs. Standalone checker passed exact stationarity and 385 independent finite consistency checks; infinite theorem is analytic.

originality.rationale: The destination-weighted complete-network refinement, with the exact preservation of global minimum entropy production and its fixed positive scaled gap for arbitrarily large fully connected networks, does not appear in the closely relevant primary sources. The explicit fixed complete-network NESS/MEPS gap follows from this concrete generator family and a rational certificate. The general all-distribution EPR decomposition is known from Esposito (2012), rather than a new standalone claim. Searched published-finding corpus for clone/lumpability/MEPS terms and read accessible prior claims; their graph-entropy and stochastic-trap results do not imply this theorem. Known log-sum and coarse-graining results are credited; residual risk is that an older general lifting result may already entail the construction.
residual_risks: An unpublished or differently named general symmetric lumping/lifting lemma may imply the exact minimizer-preserving identity; search is not a priority certificate.
The finite seed discrepancy, EPR log-sum inequality and existence of lossless entropy-preserving coarse grainings are established prior ingredients.

Esposito (2012) does already provide a general decomposition that strictly covers the KL identity used in the proof; the surviving originality claim is the quantitative complete-network family and global-minimum persistence, which could be considered a straightforward application of general coarse-graining theory.
The deterministic symmetric cloned family falls outside the independently sampled random-matrix ensembles studied by Ray and Boyd.

value.rationale: The large complete-network near-minimization trend in arXiv:2507.10476 motivates identifying whether dense connectivity and vertex count alone force small relative EPR excess. The exact specialization of known coarse-graining decomposition and destination-weighted lifting show why they do not: arbitrarily many fully connected microscopic states can retain a fixed three-state nonequilibrium core, with a rigorously quantified >18% scaled gap and strict conditional occupation penalty. This is a meaningful structural boundary, rather than a random parameter slice or claim to disprove ensemble typicality.
